CloudflareSourceInput.description: One Cloudflare zone, optionally narrowed to some of its hostnames.

api_url.description: GraphQL endpoint; synthetic://<scenario> for demo data.
api_url.title: Api Url

auth.description: A Cloudflare credential: an API token with Analytics:Read on the zone (and optionally Zone:Read, to show its domain); not needed for synthetic://.
auth.title: Auth

hostnames.description: Analyse only these hostnames; empty analyses the whole zone.
hostnames.title: Hostnames

zone_id.description: Zone ID (32 hex characters, dashboard → Overview).
zone_id.title: Zone Id

CloudflareSourceInput.title: CloudflareSourceInput

CredentialRef.description: Use a credential of the source's kind; its secret is resolved at each use.
CredentialRef.title: CredentialRef

critical_threshold.description: Optional second threshold that raises the severity.
critical_threshold.title: Critical Threshold

description.description: What the value means and why it matters; shown with findings and given to the AI explanation.
description.title: Description

identity_labels.description: Labels that identify one analysed series (e.g. job, instance); empty uses every label the query returns except the project's matcher labels.
identity_labels.title: Identity Labels

max_severity.description: Upper bound of finding severity; in event mode the severity of every finding (default high).

min_change.description: Baseline deviations must also differ from the expected value by at least this much, in the rule's unit.
min_change.title: Min Change

min_change_factor.description: Baseline deviations must also be at least this factor of the expected value (default 1.5 when neither this nor min_change is set).
min_change_factor.title: Min Change Factor

min_duration_minutes.description: How long a threshold breach must last.
min_duration_minutes.title: Min Duration Minutes

query.description: PromQL; the project's label matchers are added to every selector. $__window is replaced by the rate window (5m).
query.title: Query

slug.description: Identifier unique within the project, e.g. checkout_failures ([a-z][a-z0-9_]*, at most 40 characters).
slug.title: Slug

GrafanaSourceInput.description:
Grafana-managed alert rules selected by folder, UID and/or rule labels.

The folders' rules and the listed rules together form the selection; rule label matchers
narrow it (or alone select every rule with those labels). Instance label matchers then
narrow which alert instances of those rules count, e.g. ``project=shop``.

api_url.description: Grafana URL, e.g. https://grafana.example.com (path prefixes are kept); synthetic://<scenario> for demo data.
api_url.title: Api Url

auth.description: A Grafana credential: a service account token (Viewer role); not needed for synthetic://.
auth.title: Auth

folders.description: Folder UIDs or titles whose alert rules are analysed.
folders.title: Folders

instance_labels.description: Alert instance label matchers (e.g. project=shop), all of which must match; instances without them are not counted.
instance_labels.title: Instance Labels

rule_labels.description: Rule label matchers (e.g. team=web), all of which must match.
rule_labels.title: Rule Labels

rule_uids.description: Alert rule UIDs analysed in addition to the folders.
rule_uids.title: Rule Uids

tls_verify.description: Verify Grafana's TLS certificate; turn off only for a self-signed or internal certificate.
tls_verify.title: Tls Verify

GrafanaSourceInput.title: GrafanaSourceInput

LabelMatcher.description:
``name<op>"value"`` matcher, e.g. ``env="prod"`` or ``env=~"prod|staging"``.

An absent label matches as the empty string, as in PromQL: ``env!="dev"`` matches series
without ``env``.
LabelMatcher.title: LabelMatcher

MatchOp.description: PromQL label matching operator; regular expressions are fully anchored (RE2 syntax).
MatchOp.title: MatchOp

auth.description: A Prometheus credential (bearer or basic), or none.
auth.title: Auth

custom_rules.description: User-written PromQL rules analysed with the catalog (at most 20).
custom_rules.title: Custom Rules

ReportSchedule.description:
Run an analysis automatically at ``time`` (local to ``timezone``) on ``weekdays``.

Each run analyses the 24 h ending at the scheduled instant.

time.description: Local time of day, HH:MM (24 h).
time.title: Time

weekdays.description: Days to run on; all days by default.
weekdays.title: Weekdays

ReportSchedule.title: ReportSchedule

SentrySourceInput.description: Sentry projects of one organization, optionally narrowed to an environment and tags.

api_url.description: Sentry base URL: https://sentry.io, https://de.sentry.io for EU organizations, or a self-hosted instance (path prefixes are kept); synthetic://<scenario> for demo data.
api_url.title: Api Url

auth.description: A Sentry credential: an auth token with org:read and project:read; not needed for synthetic://.
auth.title: Auth

environment.description: Analyse only this environment; null analyses all of them.
environment.title: Environment

projects.description: Project slugs (Settings → Projects); each is analysed as its own entity.
projects.title: Projects

tags.description: Tag filters applied to every project, all of which must match.
tags.title: Tags

tls_verify.description: Verify the server's TLS certificate; turn off only for a self-hosted Sentry with a self-signed or internal certificate.
tls_verify.title: Tls Verify

SentrySourceInput.title: SentrySourceInput

SentryTag.description: Exact ``key:"value"`` tag filter added to every Sentry query of the source.

key.description: Tag key, e.g. server_name, release or a custom tag.
key.title: Key

SentryTag.title: SentryTag

key.description: Label key as set in the agent's <labels> block, e.g. project.
key.title: Key

WazuhSourceInput.description:
Wazuh agents selected by name, group and/or agent labels, read from the Wazuh indexer.

The named agents and the groups' members together form the selection; label filters
narrow it (or alone select every agent that has those labels).

agents.description: Agent names (agent.name); each is analysed as its own entity.
agents.title: Agents

api_url.description: Wazuh indexer URL, e.g. https://wazuh-indexer:9200 (path prefixes are kept); synthetic://<scenario> for demo data.
api_url.title: Api Url

auth.description: A Wazuh credential: an indexer user with read access to the alerts indices; none when the indexer needs no authentication.
auth.title: Auth

groups.description: Agent groups; their current members (from the monitoring index) are analysed together with the named agents.
groups.title: Groups

index_pattern.description: Alerts index pattern of the indexer.
index_pattern.title: Index Pattern

labels.description: Agent label filters (agent.labels.<key>), all of which must match.
labels.title: Labels

monitoring_index_pattern.description: Index of the agent snapshots the Wazuh dashboard writes; used to resolve groups.
monitoring_index_pattern.title: Monitoring Index Pattern

tls_verify.description: Verify the indexer's TLS certificate; turn off only for a self-signed or internal certificate (the Wazuh default).
tls_verify.title: Tls Verify

WazuhSourceInput.title: WazuhSourceInput

keep_reports.description: Keep only this many newest reports; older analyses are deleted automatically. Null keeps all.
keep_reports.title: Keep Reports

schedule.description: Automatic analyses; null runs analyses on demand only.
